message.content: `apply_patch` is unavailable in this shell, so I’m applying the same narrow edits with Perl, then testing.

function.name: bash
function.arguments: {"command":"cd /testbed && perl -0pi -e 's/if len\\(self\\._rows\\) in \\(0, len\\(column\\)\\):/if len(self._rows) not in (0, len(column)):/g' src/prettytable/prettytable.py && perl -0pi -e 's/class TestDeleteColumn:\\n/class TestDeleteColumn:\\n    def test_add_column_to_empty_table(self) -> None:\\n        table = PrettyTable()\\n        table.add_column(\"City\", [\"Adelaide\", \"Brisbane\"])\\n        table.add_column(\"Area\", [1295, 5905])\\n\\n        assert table.rows == [[\"Adelaide\", 1295], [\"Brisbane\", 5905]]\\n\\n    def test_add_column_with_mismatched_length_raises_error(self) -> None:\\n        table = PrettyTable()\\n        table.add_column(\"City\", [\"Adelaide\", \"Brisbane\"])\\n\\n        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match=\"Column length 1 does not match number of rows 2\"):\\n            table.add_column(\"Area\", [1295])\\n\\n/' tests/test_prettytable.py && python -m pytest -q tests/test_prettytable.py","timeout":120000}
